# LinkedIn Draft - 2026-08-08

Cloudflare released MCP v2 with a rewritten stateless protocol core, a feature lifecycle, and an SDK migration path, already running in production with early adopters.

Went through 40 links today. Here's what made the brief:

1. The next generation of MCP
   Directly affects anyone maintaining an MCP server — stateless core changes hosting and deployment decisions.

2. Cloudflare AI Search: a search engine over your own data for agents
   Managed RAG removes a common chunk of undifferentiated work; pricing preview affects build-vs-buy.

3. Introducing Kitesurf: an agent-first browser running in V8 isolates on Workers
   Potential direct cost reduction for any agent workload that drives a browser.

4. Introducing Agent Plugins 1.0.0
   A standard packaging format removes duplicated per-client plugin scaffolding, which is real time saved for anyone shipping skills and MCP servers.

5. Building Neon Object Storage
   Solves the per-branch file-state problem that makes preview environments leaky.
